hooks.name: Session Context Reminder
hooks.description: Reminds the agent of project context and available agents at the start of each session

action.prompt: A new session has started. Remind yourself: this is the portfolio project. Read ai-agent/AGENTS.md first. ai-agent/CLAUDE.md contains project commands, engineering standards, and the Definition of Done. Specialized agents are available in ai-agent/.claude/agents/ and reusable skills in ai-agent/.claude/skills/. Before implementing anything, check ai-agent/docs/requirements/ for an approved FRD and ai-agent/docs/adr/ for architecture decisions. If none exist for the requested feature, use the feature-planning skill first.
